'''Tsunanushi Suminoe''' (住吉 綱主) was a nobleman of the {{ill|Nara period|en|Nara period|qid=Q189178|lt=Nara period}} to the early {{ill|Heian period|en|Heian period|qid=Q193292|lt=Heian period}}. His [[uji-kabane|clan title]] transitioned from [[Ikehara clan|Ikehara no Kimi]] to [[Suminoe clan|Suminoe no Asomi]]. His name is also recorded as '''Nawanushi'''. He attained the Rank of [[Junior Fourth Rank|Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade]] and served as a [[Konoe no Shōshō|Captain of the Imperial Guard]].

== Career ==
In {{ill|Enryaku|en|Enryaku|qid=Q1373176|lt=Enryaku}} 4 (785), Tsunanushi was granted the Outer [[Junior Fifth Rank]], Lower Grade and appointed [[Konoe no Shōken|Inspector of the Imperial Guard]]. Later that year, he was promoted to [[Outer Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade]]. Serving as a [[Konoe no Shōken|Guard Inspector]], he concurrently held provincial posts, including {{ill|Shimōsa Province|en|Shimōsa Province|qid=Q1053695|lt=Shimōsa Dajō}} and {{ill|Hitachi Province|en|Hitachi Province|qid=Q1055353|lt=Hitachi Dajō}}. In {{ill|Enryaku|en|Enryaku|qid=Q1373176|lt=Enryaku}} 9 (790), he achieved the Inner [[Junior Fifth Rank]], Lower Grade.

In {{ill|Enryaku|en|Enryaku|qid=Q1373176|lt=Enryaku}} 10 (791), Tsunanushi and his brother successfully petitioned for a change in their clan title to reflect their ancestral ties to [[Tōjō Province|Tōjō]] and [[Suminoe District]] (now part of [[:en:Osaka City|Osaka City]]). The family name was changed to Suminoe no Asomi.

Promotions followed steadily: in {{ill|Enryaku|en|Enryaku|qid=Q1373176|lt=Enryaku}} 14 (795), he was elevated to [[Junior Fifth Rank|Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade]]; in {{ill|Enryaku|en|Enryaku|qid=Q1373176|lt=Enryaku}} 18 (799), to [[Senior Fifth Rank|Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade]]; and eventually to [[Junior Fourth Rank|Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade]], serving as [[Konoe no Shōshō|Captain of the Imperial Guard]]. He passed away on [[2nd month]] [[10th day (lunar calendar)|10th day]] of {{ill|Enryaku|en|Enryaku|qid=Q1373176|lt=Enryaku}} 24 (805), aged 77. His final Rank was [[Junior Fourth Rank|Junior Fourth Rank, Lower Grade]].

== Personality and Achievements ==
Tsunanushi excelled in {{ill|Archery|en|Archery|qid=Q108429|lt=Archery}}, earning him a position in the {{ill|Konoe|en|Konoe|qid=Q21492310|lt=Imperial Guard}}. He worked diligently, serving with dedication and gaining the trust of the Guard soldiers. His love of {{ill|Hunting|en|Hunting|qid=Q36963|lt=falconry}} and dogs was noted.<ref name="nihon-koki">*Nihon Kōki*, Enryaku 24, 2nd month, 10th day entry.</ref>
